comments.author: @BecauseGeography
comments.text:
If you're new here (which I'm sure most of you are since my channel is so small)... Geography, Geopolitics, History and the natural world absolutely fascinate me, it's why I make these videos. 

As with all the topics I cover on this channel, I would love to your thoughts on California and the amazing natural advantages it has been given. I'll let you decide whether it won the "lottery" or not quite?

Would love to hear your opinions on this so please do drop a comment for a healthy discussion (I try to read as many as possible) on what I've got right, what I've missed out and potentially should have included (or maybe things I haven't quite got right), 

Much Love to you all,

Chris 😀

replies.author: @Danquebec01
replies.text: I love your videos but I don’t know imperial or US customary units. Would love to see metric units.

comments.author: @23uncbball
comments.text: Would love if you covered the benefits and costs to desalination,  using the potential future for California and Texas as examples.  Both are goona need more water and better water efficiency to make sure the 10s of millions of people in both states.

replies.author: @BecauseGeography
replies.text: Great point! This is something I hadn’t thought to include. I knew I wanted to talk about the groundwater pumping issue - my wife is from southwest US and my father in-law talks about the issue this region has huge issues with excessive use of this as a resource. When that runs out then desalination is going to become a huge talking point - especially given the problems the Colorado river is having 😞
